item.text: I’m re-reading the current Java files before changing them again. The repo is still tiny, so the only defensible refactor now is a clearer separation of concerns rather than another round of cosmetic edits.
I’m separating formatting from sorting now. `BubbleSort` currently owns both algorithm and presentation helpers, which is the main remaining mixed responsibility in this repo.
The formatter has been extracted. I’m updating the demo and tests to use the dedicated formatter so `BubbleSort` stays focused on sorting behavior only.
The responsibility split is in place. I’m compiling and running the demo plus tests again to verify the extracted formatter didn’t change output or break the checks.

That leaves the sorter as a focused utility instead of combining algorithm and presentation.
